lead_story: The Fed is considering rate hikes to address inflation, with Governor Cook saying she's prepared to act, but Philadelphia Fed President Paulson is content with rates at current level. The US Treasury yields have fallen as oil prices plunge on Iran de-escalation hopes. The dollar has logged its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts, indicating uncertainty in the market.
